message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV files and images directly without any schema checks, dtype assertions, value-range guards, or structural validation of the incoming data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local filesystem paths only; there is no remote data fetching, and no checksum or integrity verification is performed on any files.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only maps label strings to integers via a fixed dictionary and filters out 'equal' entries; there is no distribution comparison, validation against an expected set, or noise-detection tool applied to labels.

No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious samples is performed on the dataset during data preparation; images are loaded and transformed without any integrity or anomaly checks.

No detected model integrity verification: Pretrained models are loaded via torchvision's `pretrained=True` (e.g., in SsCnn) without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop contains no backdoor defenses such as trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The evaluation uses the same data pipeline and split mechanism without any hashing, signing of evaluation data, or explicit isolation of a held-out test set from training data; the val_loader is passed in but there is no evidence of strict separation enforcement or multiple independent metrics beyon

No detected input sanitization: The inference path (the `inference` engine function and data loading) performs no shape, range, or schema validation on incoming images before passing them to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: The inference function returns raw loss and model outputs without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation on the predictions.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer vision ranking model (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
